dou_home2_tom.text: Retired ferryman. The Steam Packet company has run boats here since 1830. It is the oldest continuous passenger shipping company in the world.
Tynwald, our parliament, goes back to 979. It meets on Tynwald Day, 5 July, in the open air. Fine weather is optional.
'Mooinjer veggey' means the little people, the fairies. Say hello at Fairy Bridge, it is only polite. Slane lhiat, that is goodbye.
A pinchkin claims every stone on the beach. Do not argue. It will win. Lightly.

then.text: Back for the Queenie Scallops? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: Queenies. Small scallops, big flavour. Island pride, this.
Hot pan, butter, a minute a side, no longer. Garlic and a squeeze of lemon. If you overcook them they go like rubber.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
